note: Cross-language DeriveKey vectors for kit/core/identity. DeriveKey is HKDF-SHA256 over the Ed25519 private key seed, with an empty salt and the domain-separation string in `info`, expanded to 32 bytes. Deterministic, so every port must reproduce these bytes exactly or encrypted stores written by one language become unreadable by another. `seed` is the 32-byte Ed25519 seed; `public_key` is the Ed25519 public key derived from it, included so a port can confirm it built the keypair correctly before checking the derived key. All values are lowercase hex. Encrypt/Decrypt are NaCl secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) over this key with a random 24-byte nonce and wire layout nonce||ciphertext; the nonce makes those non-deterministic, so they are covered by round-trip tests rather than fixed vectors.
